title: 中国粉面几大派③柳州螺蛳粉：闻着臭，嗦出七百多亿 | China Noodle Schools P3 · Liuzhou 🍜
description:
螺蛳粉的臭，你是爱还是怕？评论区站个队。

【中国粉面几大派·第3集 柳州螺蛳粉】它最劝退也最上头的那股臭味，其实来自酸笋——鲜笋泡进山泉慢慢发酵，这口酸笋就是整碗的灵魂。螺蛳熬出的汤，鲜、辣、酸、爽四味交织；米粉滑弹，一嗦到底。2021年，柳州螺蛳粉制作技艺列入第五批国家级非物质文化遗产。从路边摊到一包能寄全国，2024年柳州螺蛳粉全产业链销售收入达759.6亿元，同比增长13.4%。越臭越爱，这就是螺蛳粉。（中性行业数据，非投资建议。）

Liuzhou luosifen's notorious stink comes from suan sun — fresh bamboo shoots fermented in spring water — and that sour shoot is the soul of the whole bowl. The river-snail broth layers fresh, hot, sour and brisk; the rice noodles are slick and springy, made for slurping. In 2021 its craft joined China's national intangible-heritage list. From street stalls to shelf-stable packs shipped nationwide, in 2024 the full luosifen industry chain hit 75.96 billion yuan, up 13.4% year on year. The stinkier, the better. (Neutral industry data, not investment advice.)
